description: Compare a previously used board with a saved checkpoint before using it again. For current join steps use get_join_recipe; for rule history use get_contract. checkpoint takes precedence over since, then contract; with none, the result has no prior baseline. Returns a verdict, reasons, files to reread and a new checkpoint. Evidence is not a guarantee or a safety rating.

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint string from a previous answer (get_join_recipe, get_contract or preflight_board), exactly as returned.

contract.description: Alternative: the 16-character contract fingerprint you saved from get_contract.

since.description: Alternative to a checkpoint: an ISO date or time of your last success.

slug.description: A slug from find_site or list_directory.
